item.topic: B.001 mission to tactical planning linkage
item.stem: Riverview is translating a five-year strategy into next-quarter departmental plans. Which response is most appropriate?

choices.B: Use only last year actual spending as the strategic plan
choices.C: Prepare departmental budgets without reference to strategy
choices.D: Align tactical plans and budgets with strategic objectives and measurable performance targets

item.explanation_correct: Planning connects long-term strategy to operational budgets, responsibility assignments, and measurable targets.

correct_choice_verification.rationale: Choice D describes the cascade from strategy to tactical plans and budgets with measurable targets, which is the correct linkage under planning frameworks. Choices A, B, and C each describe a broken or absent strategy-to-operations connection.

A.content_summary: Explains why eliminating nonfinancial goals is wrong — quality, customer satisfaction, and employee development are essential components of a balanced strategic performance framework.
